study type: Secondary analysis of a retrospective cohort study
cohort: 10,532 singleton newborns born to mothers with diabetes, hypertensive disorders, and/or FGR
finding: Lower gestational age, presence of meconium, non-spontaneous labor, and cesarean delivery were positively associated with RDS in early-term infants, while chorioamnionitis and endometritis were stronger risk factors for RDS in full-term infants.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was positively associated with RDS in both early-term and full-term infants.
